veh.SetDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath() + 'vehicle/')

initRot = chrono.QuatFromAngleZ(1.57)

# Contact method
contact_method = chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC
contact_vis = False

# Simulation step sizes
step_size = 1e-3
tire_step_size = step_size

# Time interval between two render frames
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50

# Create the HMMWV vehicle, set parameters, and initialize

vehicle.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(initLoc, initRot))
vehicle.SetTireType(tire_model)
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(tire_step_size)


vehicle.Initialize()

vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type)

vehicle.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# Create the terrain
patch_mat = chrono.ChContactMaterialNSC()
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())
patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat, 
    chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT),
    chrono.GetChronoDataFile('vehicle/terrain/meshes/Highway_col.obj'),

vis.AddSkyBox()

throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.irrlicht as chronoirr

# 1. Initialize the PyChrono environment and core components

chrono.SetChronoDataPath(chrono.GetChronoDataPath())  # Ensure data path is set

# Simulation parameters
step_size = 0.002  # integration step size
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # 50 FPS rendering

# 2. Add the required physical systems and objects as specified

# Create the vehicle system: Full HMMWV
# Use TMEASY tire model, mesh visualization for all vehicle parts
contact_method = chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC  # Non-smooth contact (default)
init_loc = chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 1.0)  # Initial position (x=0, y=0, z=1m above ground)
init_rot = chrono.ChQuaternionD(1, 0, 0, 0)  # No initial rotation

vehicle = veh.HMMWV_Full(contact_method)
vehicle.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(veh.ChassisCollisionType_NONE)  # We'll rely on terrain collision
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysD(init_loc, init_rot))
vehicle.SetTireType(veh.TireModelType_TMEASY)
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(step_size)
vehicle.SetInitFwdVel(0)

# Enable mesh visualization for all vehicle parts
vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(veh.VisualizationType_MESH)

vehicle.Initialize()

# 3. Set necessary default parameters such as positions, forces, and interactions.

# Create the terrain using custom mesh for collision and visualization
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())

# Load collision mesh
collision_mesh = chrono.ChTriangleMeshConnected()
collision_mesh.LoadWavefrontMesh(chrono.GetChronoDataPath() + "vehicle/hmmwv/mesh/Highway_col.obj", True, True)
terrain_mesh_shape = chrono.ChTriangleMeshShape()
terrain_mesh_shape.SetMesh(collision_mesh)
terrain_mesh_shape.SetName("terrain_collision_mesh")
terrain_mesh_shape.SetStatic(True)

# Create a rigid body for terrain collision
terrain_body = chrono.ChBody()
terrain_body.SetBodyFixed(True)
terrain_body.AddAsset(terrain_mesh_shape)
terrain_body.GetCollisionModel().ClearModel()
terrain_body.GetCollisionModel().AddTriangleMesh(
    collision_mesh, False, False, chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0), chrono.ChMatrix33D(1), 0.01)
terrain_body.GetCollisionModel().BuildModel()
terrain_body.SetCollide(True)

# Add visual mesh
visual_mesh = chrono.ChTriangleMeshShape()
visual_mesh.LoadWavefrontMesh(chrono.GetChronoDataPath() + "vehicle/hmmwv/mesh/Highway_vis.obj", True, True)
visual_mesh.SetName("terrain_visual_mesh")
visual_mesh.SetStatic(True)
terrain_body.AddAsset(visual_mesh)

# Add a texture for better visualization (optional)
texture = chrono.ChTexture()
texture.SetTextureFilename(chrono.GetChronoDataPath() + "vehicle/hmmwv/mesh/grass.jpg")
terrain_body.AddAsset(texture)

# Add terrain body to the system
vehicle.GetSystem().Add(terrain_body)

# Initialize the terrain system (not using RigidTerrain's default since we do custom)
# But we keep the terrain object for possible future extensions
terrain.Initialize()

# Create the interactive driver system
driver = veh.ChIrrGuiDriver(vehicle)

# Set driver input time response (optional smoothing)
driver.SetSteeringDelta(0.1)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(0.1)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(0.1)

# Initialize Irrlicht visualization
application = chronoirr.ChIrrApp(vehicle.GetSystem(), "HMMWV Full Vehicle on Mesh Terrain",
                                 chronoirr.dimension2du(1280, 720))

application.AddTypicalSky()
application.AddTypicalLights()
application.AddTypicalCamera(chronoirr.vector3df(0, -10, 3))
application.AssetBindAll()
application.AssetUpdateAll()

# Set timestep for simulation and rendering
application.SetTimestep(step_size)
application.SetTryRealtime(True)

# Simulation loop variables
time = 0
render_time = 0

# Start simulation loop
application.SetPaused(False)

while application.GetDevice().run():
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Synchronize modules
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain_body)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    application.Synchronize("", driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation by step_size
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    application.Advance(step_size)

    # Render scene at 50 FPS
    if time - render_time >= render_step_size:
        render_time = time
        application.BeginScene()
        application.DrawAll()
        application.EndScene()

trackPoint = chrono.ChVector3d(-3.0, 0.0, 1.1)

# Contact method
contact_method = chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC
contact_vis = False

# Simulation step sizes
step_size = 1e-3
tire_step_size = step_size

# Time interval between two render frames
render_step_size = 1.0 / 50  # FPS = 50

# Create the HMMWV vehicle, set parameters, and initialize

vehicle = veh.HMMWV_Full()  # veh.HMMWV_Reduced()  could be another choice here
vehicle.SetContactMethod(contact_method)
vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(chassis_collision_type)
vehicle.SetChassisFixed(False)
vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysd(initLoc, initRot))
vehicle.SetTireType(tire_model)
vehicle.SetTireStepSize(tire_step_size)

vehicle.Initialize()

vehicle.SetChassisVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSuspensionVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetSteeringVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetWheelVisualizationType(vis_type)
vehicle.SetTireVisualizationType(vis_type)

vehicle.GetSystem().SetCollisionSystemType(chrono.ChCollisionSystem.Type_BULLET)

# Create the terrain
patch_mat = chrono.ChMaterialSurfaceNSC()  # Corrected: ChContactMaterialNSC -> ChMaterialSurfaceNSC
patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)
terrain = veh.RigidTerrain(vehicle.GetSystem())

# First patch (Highway)
patch = terrain.AddPatch(
    patch_mat,
    chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT),
    chrono.GetChronoDataFile('vehicle/terrain/meshes/Highway_col.obj'),
    True, 0.01, False)

vis_mesh = chrono.ChTriangleMeshConnected()
vis_mesh.LoadWavefrontMesh(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/meshes/Highway_vis.obj"), True, True)
tri_mesh_shape = chrono.ChVisualShapeTriangleMesh()
tri_mesh_shape.SetMesh(vis_mesh)
tri_mesh_shape.SetMutable(False)
patch.GetGroundBody().AddVisualShape(tri_mesh_shape)

# --- Added new terrain patch as per instructions ---

# Create a new material for the second patch (can reuse patch_mat or create new)
patch_mat2 = chrono.ChMaterialSurfaceNSC()
patch_mat2.SetFriction(0.9)
patch_mat2.SetRestitution(0.01)

# Add the new patch at (0, -42, 0) with bump.obj mesh
patch2 = terrain.AddPatch(
    patch_mat2,
    chrono.ChCoordsysd(chrono.ChVector3d(0, -42, 0), chrono.QUNIT),
    chrono.GetChronoDataFile('vehicle/terrain/meshes/bump.obj'),
    True, 0.01, False)

# Set color (0.5, 0.5, 0.8)
patch2.SetColor(chrono.ChColor(0.5, 0.5, 0.8))

# Set texture dirt.jpg with scaling factors 6.0, 6.0
patch2.SetTexture(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('vehicle/terrain/textures/dirt.jpg'), 6.0, 6.0)

terrain.Initialize()

# Create the vehicle Irrlicht interface

vis = veh.ChWheeledVehicleVisualSystemIrrlicht()
vis.SetWindowTitle('HMMWV Demo')
vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 1024)
vis.SetChaseCamera(trackPoint, 6.0, 0.5)
vis.Initialize()
vis.AddLogo(chrono.GetChronoDataFile('logo_pychrono_alpha.png'))
vis.AddLightDirectional()
vis.AddSkyBox()
vis.AttachVehicle(vehicle.GetVehicle())

# Create the driver system
driver = veh.ChInteractiveDriverIRR(vis)

# Set the time response for steering and throttle keyboard inputs.
steering_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1 (or from 0 to -1)
throttle_time = 1.0  # time to go from 0 to +1
braking_time = 0.3   # time to go from 0 to +1
driver.SetSteeringDelta(render_step_size / steering_time)
driver.SetThrottleDelta(render_step_size / throttle_time)
driver.SetBrakingDelta(render_step_size / braking_time)

driver.Initialize()

# ---------------
# Simulation loop
# ---------------

# output vehicle mass
print("VEHICLE MASS: ", vehicle.GetVehicle().GetMass())

# Number of simulation steps between miscellaneous events
render_steps = math.ceil(render_step_size / step_size)

# Initialize simulation frame counter
realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
step_number = 0
render_frame = 0

while vis.Run():
    time = vehicle.GetSystem().GetChTime()

    # Render scene and output POV-Ray data
    if (step_number % render_steps == 0):
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()
        render_frame += 1

    # Get driver inputs
    driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()

    # Update modules (process inputs from other modules)
    driver.Synchronize(time)
    terrain.Synchronize(time)
    vehicle.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)
    vis.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs)

    # Advance simulation for one timestep for all modules
    driver.Advance(step_size)
    terrain.Advance(step_size)
    vehicle.Advance(step_size)
    vis.Advance(step_size)

    # Increment frame number
    step_number += 1

    # Spin in place for real time to catch up
    realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)
